newsitem.title: DUBAI: Active trade in UAE shares in week, index dips.
newsitem.headline: Active trade in UAE shares in week, index dips.

text.p: Trade on the unofficial United Arab Emirates stock market was active in the week to Thursday with the index edging lower mainly on a steep decline in the shares of an large insurance company, brokers said.
The National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) 27-share index ebbed to 2,489.91 points from 2,493.46.

Brokers attributed the slip to a 250 dirham decline in Abu Dhabi National Insurance Co to 1,100 dirhams. They said the company's shares had risen over the past month on expectations that it would distribute bonus shares, but they fell this week when no issue was announced.
Ten shares rose, four fell and 12 were steady this week.

Al-Ain Al-Ahlia Insurance continued its rise, adding 100 dirhams to 1,450. National Bank of Dubai rose five dirhams to 660 and market leader Etisalat, the UAE's telecommunications company, gained five dirhams to 935.
NBAD was up 10 dirhams at 480 and United Arab Bank rose 15 dirhams to 225.
